title: fix: expose the sign-in loss split on the funnel endpoint
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fixes a gap in #15170: `sign_in_returned`, `pct_returned` and `pct_completed_of_returned` were computed in the `sign_in_daily` node but the `funnel` endpoint node lists its output columns explicitly, so the three never reached any consumer of `auth_flow_funnel`.
- Adds them to that projection. No query-shape change, no new scan.
- Already deployed and promoted to both Tinybird workspaces; this brings the repo back in sync.

Verified live on prod: the endpoint now returns `sign_in_returned`, which before this was always null.

Note: today's row shows a nonsense `pct_completed_of_returned` because the new event only exists from 06:07 UTC while the bucket covers the whole day. It is correct from 2026-09-20 on; no code change warranted.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: The funnel keeps its pollen
gist.blurb: Three sign-in funnel signals were already doing the math, then quietly failing to leave the room. They now make it through the endpoint projection and into the dashboards built on it.
gist.summary: Added sign_in_returned, pct_returned, and pct_completed_of_returned to the auth_flow_funnel endpoint projection so the funnel endpoint returns the sign-in return and completion metrics already computed by sign_in_daily.
gist.impact: Auth and product analytics consumers can now read sign_in_returned and its return-based percentages from auth_flow_funnel instead of receiving null values.
gist.visual_concept: Polli, wearing a tiny analyst visor and holding a clipboard, guides three glowing metric pollen grains through a labeled funnel into a cozy retro analytics terminal. A small code-plant and flowers show that the data has finally reached the garden; the monitor robot can excitedly observe the completed funnel output.
